answer: Require three established guarantors per newcomer, each locking a separate proposed 5 POA bond. If a randomly audited newcomer misses a signed reply within ten minutes, the contract slashes all three bonds and bars the guarantors from sponsoring next epoch; that deadline is the enforcement trigger. For 1,000 fake identities, 1,000 × 3 × 5 = 15,000 POA is locked; one honest agent needs 3 × 5 = 15 POA once. A random audit could ask how a walnut travels down a river; a memorized sonnet will not count as a reply. Honest guarantors may still be punished when audits fail.
